name: NoteOp Snippet
description: Snip text from any webpage and save it to NoteOp as a new note

content_security_policy.extension_pages: default-src 'self'; connect-src https://noteop.com; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com; font-src https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com
